Title: Diagnosis
Details: 
The failing test calls CSVFormat.DEFAULT.withHeader().withNullString("").withIgnoreEmptyHeaders(true).parse(in).iterator() where the CSV content has an empty header value. The bug report indicates a NullPointerException (NPE) occurs when an empty header string and a nullString of "" are both set.

From the `CSVFormat.withNullString(String nullString)` method, setting nullString just sets the nullString field in CSVFormat and returns a new CSVFormat instance with it unchanged otherwise.

The `CSVParser` constructor calls `initializeHeader()` which creates a header map if the format has headers specified. If the header array is empty, it reads the first record from the file as the header values.

In `initializeHeader()`, when building the header map the code iterates over the headerRecord array and builds a map from header names to indexes. It checks if a header is empty (`header.trim().isEmpty()`) and handles ignoreEmptyHeaders setting.

When `ignoreEmptyHeaders` is true and an empty header is encountered, the empty header is allowed. Yet the map still maps an empty string header to an index.

Considering the CSV content has empty header strings due to ",," in the first line, and nullString is set to "", it is possible the empty string headers in the map combined with the nullString setting lead to a mismatch during parsing or record creation.

The CSVRecord constructor simply stores the values array, the header map (mapping), and other details.

The call to `CSVRecord.toMap()` calls `putIn(map)` which iterates over the header map entries. Because some headers are empty strings and nullString is "", there might be inconsistencies or null dereferences when accessing values by header names or mapping empty headers.

Recent bug reports about NPEs in `CSVRecord.toMap()` when no headers exist or when headers mismatch the record length reinforce this pattern.

In summary, the bug likely arises because the combination of empty headers (produced from the first line in the CSV) and the nullString setting of "" causes the header map or subsequent record processing to reference null or empty keys and values leading to NullPointerException. The handling of empty headers in initializeHeader and the interaction with nullString is not correctly guarded against causing an NPE.

The root cause is the insufficient handling of empty header strings in the header map combined with usage of a nullString "". This causes downstream NPEs during record creation or mapping.

This diagnosis explains why the failure occurs specifically when setting withNullString("") together with empty headers and ignoreEmptyHeaders(true) in the parsed CSV data.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
